title: IPO Report Card: 30 to 60 Days After Listing — August 2026
description: Out of 28 IPOs that listed between 30 and 60 days ago, 19 are currently trading above their original IPO price. 9 IPOs are trading below their original issue .

faq.a: A Mainboard IPO is when a company lists its shares on the main exchanges like the National Stock Exchange (NSE) or Bombay Stock Exchange (BSE), typically for larger, more established companies.
An SME IPO is for Small and Medium Enterprises (SMEs) that list their shares on dedicated platforms within the NSE or BSE, designed for smaller companies with different listing requirements.
The issue price is the fixed price per share at which the company offers its shares to the public during the IPO.
The current price is the latest trading price of the share on the stock exchange at the time this report was compiled.

faq.q: What does "return vs issue price" mean?
faq.a: This percentage shows how much the current market price of a share has changed compared to its original IPO issue price. A positive percentage means the current price is higher than the IPO price, while a negative percentage means it's lower.
